title: Improving the Distributional Alignment of LLMs using Supervision
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM alignment with human response distributions using datasets like the World Values Survey (WVS), which the authors state covers 'diverse subjective topics, including... various moral opinions and values'. Furthermore, the analysis explicitly benchmarks the model's performance across a wide range of religious demographic groups, including Buddhist, Hindu, Jew, Muslim, and various Christian denominations.
